contents.text: Am I allowed to paste a pump manual into a public chatbot?
The sources do not contain information about pasting pump manuals into public chatbots.

IT policy IT-POL-003: Using AI tools
# IT policy IT-POL-003: Using AI tools
Don't paste Contoso documents, drawings, customer data or personal data into public AI chatbots or translation sites.
Their providers may store what you type.
Use the Contoso Knowledge Assistant for questions about Contoso's documents.
It answers from documents you're allowed to read and shows its sources.
Report any document you pasted into a public tool by mistake to the IT service desk, so that the security team can assess it.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual
# CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual
Edition 2009.
Contoso Industrial, Fluid Systems division.
Keep this manual with the pump for the life of the equipment and pass it on with the pump if it is moved or sold.
# 1 Safety
Read this manual before installing, operating or servicing the pump.
Work on the pump only when you are trained for the task and the pump is isolated as your site's procedures require.
- Isolate the motor electrically and lock it out before any work on the pump.
- Release the pressure in the casing and the seal-water line before opening any connection.
- Wear safety glasses and gloves when handling the mechanical seal.
The seal faces are brittle and their edges are sharp.
- Never run the pump dry or against a closed suction valve.
- Lift the pump only by the lifting lugs on the baseplate, never by the motor eyebolt.

CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Operating and Maintenance Manual › 5 Commissioning › 5.1 Checks before the first start
# 5 Commissioning
## 5.1 Checks before the first start
1. Check that the rotating assembly turns freely by hand.
2. Check the coupling alignment and fit the coupling guard.
3. Check that the bearings are greased; pumps leave the factory greased for 4,000 hours.
4. Flush the suction pipe and the seal-water line before connecting them.
